Custom shader material

Soft pearl shading with a gold, lavender and teal palette. Evaluate the JavaScript cell once before evaluating the example below. The upper-left studio light is built into the shader, so the finish stays consistent while rotating the scene.

Atoms and faces: MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Gold"]]. Other presets: "Lavender", "Teal", "Ice" and "Glass".

Optional controls: PearlMaterial[preset, roughness, grain, opacity, highlight, wash]. Increase grain for texture, highlight for shine, or wash for colour variation.

Bonds: MeshMaterial[PearlBondMaterial["Bond", "Ice", "Lavender"]]. The last two colours tint the bond ends. Use "GoldBond" for gold bonds. Optional controls: PearlBondMaterial[base, start, end, bleed, roughness, grain]; set bleed to 0 to remove the end tints.

Path tracing: add "Renderer" -> "PathTracing" and "MultipleImportanceSampling" -> True. For a five-second preview, use "SleepAfter" -> 5 1000 and Rasterize[..., "ExposureTime" -> 5]. Increase both times for a cleaner image.

Minimal example

Two atoms joined by a bond, using both material functions.

Graphics3D[{ {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Ice"]], Sphere[{-1, 0, 0}, .35]}, {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Lavender"]], Sphere[{1, 0, 0}, .35]}, {MeshMaterial[PearlBondMaterial["Bond", "Ice", "Lavender"]], Cylinder[{{-1, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0}}, .09]} }, Background -> White, ImageSize -> 450, ViewPoint -> {0, -3, 1}] (*VB[*)(Graphics3D[{{MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Ice"]], Sphere[{-1, 0, 0}, 0.35]}, {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Lavender"]], Sphere[{1, 0, 0}, 0.35]}, {MeshMaterial[PearlBondMaterial["Bond", "Ice", "Lavender"]], Cylinder[{{-1, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0}}, 0.09]}}, Background -> GrayLevel[1], ImageSize -> 450, ViewPoint -> {0, -3, 1}])(*,*)(*"1:eJy1ksFKAzEQhndVRBc8+Ai+geBZhFbRwhZKFzxvuvunOxiTNdmt1tfxIbz7EPo0okmWtLaUemoOP5lh5p9vQs4maszjKIrMgZU7JUruLiaxcqtZXVFhLq75fqhIyTR8byXy3edW+opzIKWnFq3Ob14aSENKmnxplA9hqiFroImJrvPEyghMi5DO3LBBgW7MoZWsrqCxCkE/9pANIi+a+/N5tWu4I+fMZpAl9D+EcYDbEaGfdhoIe0qWC0rn7hLhLTdgu0x/LmiZWSBte+jtOyZfb/Vl8v5nx3Er4H9TjxUPU61aWXYrH3c/bJ5iBuF91ppcweCRTZHRK+gj3lhwT3geKZLr0B7p25E751/1Zr5+"*)(*]VB*)

Cage

The cosahedral cage, camera, atom sizes and bond connectivity, rendered with the pearl materials

PearlCageFigure = Module[ {phi, cageSites, edgePairs, view, carbonIndices, boronIndices, hSites, cageBonds, terminalBonds, faces, sitePreset}, phi = GoldenRatio; cageSites = N@Join[ Flatten[Table[{0, s, t phi}, {s, {-1, 1}}, {t, {-1, 1}}], 1], Flatten[Table[{s, t phi, 0}, {s, {-1, 1}}, {t, {-1, 1}}], 1], Flatten[Table[{t phi, 0, s}, {s, {-1, 1}}, {t, {-1, 1}}], 1]]; edgePairs = Select[Subsets[Range[Length[cageSites]], {2}], Abs[EuclideanDistance @@ cageSites[[#]] - 2] < 10^-6 &]; view = Normalize[{2.4, -2.8, 2.1}]; carbonIndices = First@MaximalBy[edgePairs, Dot[Mean[cageSites[[#]]], view] &]; boronIndices = Complement[Range[12], carbonIndices]; hSites = (# + .78 Normalize[#]) & /@ cageSites; sitePreset[i_] := If[MemberQ[carbonIndices, i], "Ice", "Lavender"]; cageBonds = ({MeshMaterial[PearlBondMaterial["Bond", sitePreset[#[[1]]], sitePreset[#[[2]]], .30, .35, 3 .012]], Cylinder[cageSites[[#]], .055]} &) /@ edgePairs; terminalBonds = Table[{ MeshMaterial[PearlBondMaterial["GoldBond", sitePreset[i], "Gold", .25, .32, .012]], Cylinder[{cageSites[[i]], hSites[[i]]}, .045]}, {i, 12}]; faces = MeshPrimitives[ConvexHullMesh[cageSites], 2]; Graphics3D[{ {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Glass", .60, 0., .12, 0.]], faces}, cageBonds, terminalBonds, {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Lavender", .36, 2 .014]], Sphere[cageSites[[boronIndices]], .23]}, {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Ice", .34, 2 .008]], Sphere[cageSites[[carbonIndices]], .27]}, {MeshMaterial[PearlMaterial["Gold", .32, 2 .012]], Sphere[hSites, .13]}, {Black, Directive[FontSize -> 18], (Text[Style["C", Bold], # + .4 {1,0,-1}] &)@ First@MaximalBy[cageSites[[carbonIndices]], Dot[#, view] &], (Text[Style["B", Bold], # + {0.4,-0.2,-1.8}] &)@ First@MaximalBy[cageSites[[boronIndices]], Dot[#, view] &], (Text[Style["H", Bold], # + .45 Normalize[#]] &)@ First@MaximalBy[hSites, Dot[#, view] &]} }, Boxed -> False, Background -> White, SphericalRegion -> True, ViewPoint -> {2.4, -2.8, 2.1}, ViewVertical -> {0,0,1}, PlotRange -> All, ImageSize -> Large, "AcesToneMapping" -> False, "OrthographicCameraZoom" -> .72] ] (*VB[*)(FrontEndRef["F160fc7f8-e1ac-4965-b016-d462954a1fb0"])(*,*)(*"1:eJxTTMoPSmNkYGAoZgESHvk5KRCeEJBwK8rPK3HNS3GtSE0uLUlMykkNVgUJG5oZpCWbp1nophomJuuaWJqZ6iYZGJrpppiYGVmamiQapiUZAACZUhW2"*)(*]VB*)

Path-traced pearl cage

The same geometry and material calls with "Renderer" -> "PathTracing". The material factories automatically use physical materials and locally generated pigment, roughness and normal textures, with two soft studio lights. Rasterization continues to use the custom shader.

Show[PearlCageFigure, "Renderer" -> "PathTracing", "MultipleImportanceSampling" -> True, "EnvironmentIntensity" -> .50, "BackgroundAlpha" -> 0, "Bounces" -> 5, "SleepAfter" -> 30 1000]
